gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-stick: Stick reads as a plain sans drawn with tubelike lines, its exits wide enough to let light through. Happy Monkey brings the loud, ruler-straight swagger up top, and the two stay out of each other's way.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-suse: SUSE reads as a plain sans with rope-thick curves and bowls tipped open.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-suse-mono: SUSE Mono gives a plain sans feel, with open curves and extra room on both sides of every letter. And Happy Monkey, drawn like neon tube, makes a loud, glowing contrast to that quiet spacing.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-tajawal: Fineliner flat, loud and friendly. Happy Monkey draws every stroke at one flat line, while Tajawal follows with a broad, open hook in its c.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-tasa-explorer: Distinctive wire-bent letters make Happy Monkey stand out across a whole word, and TASA Explorer finishes its curves like lifted brush strokes. One is built to be noticed; the other to be read.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-tasa-orbiter: TASA Orbiter reads as a sans with every small counter kept clear. Happy Monkey's vertical and horizontal strokes carry identical weight, so the heading looks drawn with a stencil of one line.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-teachers: Modern and wiry, Teachers looks like thin steel rod bent into letters. Happy Monkey sits above it with ruler-straight, bold strokes, and the pair makes a lively, sturdy-over-slender page.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-telex: Telex is a sans-serif with curvy letters that feel unclamped. Happy Monkey's stems and arches share identical thickness, so a long read slides from rigid heading into loose, easygoing text.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-tenor-sans: Chunky one-weight headline letters meet a quieter body with light but visible stroke variation, a tempered contrast. Happy Monkey and Tenor Sans simply refuse to flatten each other.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-tirra: Happy Monkey's strokes are ruler-straight and wide-gapped. Tirra answers with round forms like open parentheses, a plain sans that makes the loud heading feel friendly.
